summary.title: Git Tutorials for Beginners & Professionals | Atlassian Git Tutorial
summary.one_liner: A categorized index of Atlassian's Git tutorials, covering beginner basics through advanced topics like rebasing, reset/revert, reflog, hooks, and Git LFS.
takeaways: Git is organized into beginner topics (setup, saving, undoing, branching, syncing) and advanced topics.
Migration guides cover moving from SVN and Perforce to Git.
Advanced articles explain merging vs. rebasing, reset/checkout/revert, refs and reflog, hooks, and Git LFS.
The page is primarily a table of contents linking to individual tutorials and a Git cheat sheet.
summary.summary: This is Atlassian's Git tutorial hub, which lists the individual guides in a structured sequence. Topics are grouped into Beginner (getting started, saving and inspecting changes, undoing changes, rewriting history, syncing with remotes, branches, comparing workflows), Migration (SVN and Perforce to Git), and Advanced Tips (merging vs. rebasing, reflog, hooks, Git LFS, large repositories). The page itself contains only the index and links; the actual explanations live in the linked articles, and the excerpt provides no detailed content. It also points to Bitbucket Cloud-specific guides and a Git cheat sheet.
